project_description: Complete proxy-supported prompt-cache locality optimization by synthesizing provider-scoped opaque downstream conversation-affinity fallbacks when clients omit an explicit prompt-cache key, projecting those values only through explicit backend/provider-profile capabilities, repairing direct OpenAI Responses prompt_cache_key forwarding, and preserving secure-session, route-affinity, continuation, prompt-cache residency/control, and keep-warm as separate authorities.
